TASK-101.title: Implement authentication and session JWT handling
TASK-101.description: Develop secure token generation, validation, and refresh token rotation logic for authenticated API requests.
acceptance_criteria: JWT access tokens must expire in 15 minutes
Refresh token rotation must invalidate prior refresh tokens upon use
Passwords must be hashed using bcrypt or Argon2 with adequate work factor
Authentication endpoints must return standard OAuth2 compliant token payload

TASK-102.title: Design user profile and database models
TASK-102.description: Construct SQLAlchemy user profile models, schema definitions, and initial Alembic database migrations.
acceptance_criteria: User model must include email, hashed_password, full_name, and role columns
Email field must be unique and properly indexed
Alembic migration must run cleanly forwards and backwards
Database session pool must handle concurrent connections gracefully

TASK-103.title: Develop password reset endpoints and notification hooks
TASK-103.description: Implement password reset token issuance, timed expiration verification, and event emission for email notifications.
acceptance_criteria: Reset tokens must expire within 1 hour of issuance
Password reset endpoint must verify token authenticity before password update
Notification service hook must trigger on password change event
Unit tests must cover expired token rejection and replay attack prevention
